indexPrompt.vlm-gate-starts-at-zero: A Flamingo-style layer starts training with its gate alpha at 0, so its output is exactly the layer below, yet the gradient on alpha is not zero. Compute that gradient, take one plain gradient-descent step and find what the gradient on an entry of the output matrix is afterwards, then show that also starting the output matrix at zero leaves every weight of the new layer stuck forever.
indexPrompt.vlm-long-captions-short-answers: One instruction-tuning batch holds eight examples: two long descriptions of a photo whose answers are 144 tokens, and six one-word questions whose answers are 4 tokens. The mean loss per answer token is 1.6 on a description and 0.3 on a short answer. Compute the loss the loop logs when it flattens the batch and calls cross entropy with its default settings, then under two other ways of weighting the examples, and generalise the three rules with one exponent.
indexPrompt.vlm-one-softmax-or-two: In the LLaVA design one softmax covers the visual tokens and the text tokens together. Show that the head's output is a weighted average of a pure image reading and a pure text reading, and find how the image's share changes when a photo is sent at twice the resolution.
indexPrompt.vlm-question-before-the-photo: A team lays out its sequences as the question tokens, then the photo's visual tokens, then the answer, under the usual causal mask, and wants to compute the photo positions' keys and values once and reuse them for every new question. Say which of the four statements about those stored keys and values is right.
indexPrompt.vlm-snapping-visual-tokens: A LLaVA-style model trains only its projector, and each visual token is replaced by the nearest row of the language model's own embedding table before the language model reads it. What does training do to the projector?
